extracted.name: No-Mayo Pasta Salad
extracted.description: This versatile no-mayo pasta salad recipe is easy to prepare with both ranch and Italian dressing. Add your favorite veggies for a customized salad.
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook pasta at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain, rinse with cold water until cool, drain, and set aside.
Combine pasta, tomatoes, cucumber, and onion in a large bowl.
Stir ranch dressing and Italian dressing together in a separate bowl; stir into pasta mixture to coat.
